race.title: Boyle Sports Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Likeable veteran TOMMY'S OSCAR looks the most solid option in a tricky race for betting purposes. Palamon is likely to have a say if on a going day, with similar comments applying to 3-time C&D winner Geryville . TOMMY'S OSCAR (IRE) PALAMON (IRE) GERYVILLE (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Tommy's Oscar (5/4), Palamon (6/4), The Bluesman (9/2), Gunsight Ridge (25/1), Geryville (25/1)
